arabic text:
(FARSHE MAATAM PE TERE, ASHK AANKHONSE GIRE
ZAKHM ZEHRA KE LIYE, ASHK MARHAM WO BANE)
(KOI MAUSAM BHI RAHE, HAR SADAA ROE TUJHE)
(YA HUSSAIN MAWLA MERE)
english translation text:
Upon the floor of your mourning, tears fall from our eyes;
may those tears become balm for Zahra’s wounds.
Whatever the season, may every voice continue to weep for you—
O Hussain, my Master.

arabic text:
(TU NAMAAZO KI BAQAA, TU AZAANO KI SADAA,
TERE SAJDE KI QASAM, KHUD BHI KHAATA HAI KHUDA)
(TU HAI SARDAARE JINAA, HAM AZAADAR TERE)
(YA HUSSAIN MAWLA MERE)
english translation text:
You are the survival of prayer and the call of the adhan;
by your prostration, God Himself bears witness.
You are the leader of Paradise, and we are your mourners—
O Hussain, my Master.

arabic text:
(JUR’ATO AZME ALI, TERI RAG RAG ME BASI
DAULATE SABR HAME, TERE HI GHAR SE MILI)
(TERE GHAZI KE ALAM, AAJ GHAR GHAR HAI SAJE)
(YA HUSSAIN MAWLA MERE)
english translation text:
Ali’s courage and resolve flow through every vein of yours;
we received the treasure of patience from your household.
The standards of your Ghazi are raised in every home today—
O Hussain, my Master.

arabic text:
(TUNE SAJDA JO KIYA BARSARE KARBOBALA,
LAAE JIBREEL-E-AMEEN BAS YE PAIGHAAME KHUDA)
(AY HUSSAIN IBNE ALI, KHUSH KIYA TUNE MUJHE)
(YA HUSSAIN MAWLA MERE)
english translation text:
When you prostrated upon the land of Karbala,
Jibraeel-e-Ameen brought this message from God:
‘O Hussain, son of Ali, you have pleased Me’—
O Hussain, my Master.

arabic text:
(BARSARE NAWKE SINA, ZIKRE HAQ TERI ZABAAN
BOLA QURANE MUBEEN, AISA QAARI HAI KAHAAN)
(APNE KHAALIQ KI SANAA, ZERE KHANJAR JO KARE)
(YA HUSSAIN MAWLA MERE)
english translation text:
From the point of the spear, your tongue continued to remember the Truth;
the Qur’an declared, ‘Where can such a reciter be found—
one who praises his Creator beneath the dagger?’
O Hussain, my Master.

arabic text:
(WO TERI TASHNA LABI, HAAE FARZANDE ALI
HAATH MALTI THI BAHAN, TEGH GARDEN PE CHALI)
(ISSI AFSOS ME AB, ALQAMA ROTI RAHE)
(YA HUSSAIN MAWLA MERE)
english translation text:
Alas for your parched lips, O son of Ali;
your sister wrung her hands as the sword was drawn across your neck.
In grief over this, may the Alqama continue to weep—
O Hussain, my Master.

arabic text:
(TERE BACHONPE RAHI, TEEN DIN TASHNA LABI
BHUL SAKTE HI NAHI, TERI MAZLOOMI KABHI)
(ASHK GIR GIR KE KAHE, FARSHE MAJLIS PE MERE)
(YA HUSSAIN MAWLA MERE)
english translation text:
Your children remained thirsty for three days;
we can never forget your oppression.
As tears fall upon the floor of my majlis, they cry out—
O Hussain, my Master.

arabic text:
(ZIKR SE TERE HUWA, MEI TO "REHAANE" AZAA
TERE GHAZI KA KARAM, TERI MAADAR KI ATAA)
(KYUN NA HAR ROZ RAHE, HAR GHARI SAATH MERE)
(YA HUSSAIN MAWLA MERE)
english translation text:
Through remembrance of you, I, ‘Rehan’, became a servant of mourning;
it is the grace of your Ghazi and the gift of your mother.
Why should this remembrance not remain with me every day and every moment?
O Hussain, my Master.
